svg.aria-label: South African compliance coverage matrix for the za_local packages
svg.text: Developed and included in each za_local package, and what no package covers. Reviewed 8 October 2026.
PAYE: cumulative method, rebates, medical credits
Fringe benefits: company car, accommodation, loans
Tax directives, lump sums and severance tax
Travel allowance, subsistence and business trips
Notice, severance and leave payout on termination
Sectoral minimum wages and bargaining councils
Tax invoices, credit and debit notes
Other bank layouts and split pay
Corrections, off-cycle runs and back pay
Leave liability, bonus accruals, cost allocation
Statutory sources and approved rate packs
SA ID, tax number and work-permit checks
Payroll readiness gate for new employees
EMP201 report and statutory submissions summary
Employment Equity workforce, movement, plan progress
Hiring funnel, cost per hire, onboarding compliance
SARS eFiling, BRS and e@syFile submission
Certified Employment Equity forms and filing
SETA portal submission and grant claims
Corporate and provisional tax returns (calendar entry only)
CIPC returns and beneficial ownership (calendar entry only)
Specialist VAT: mixed supplies, imports, customs, property
Green tick: the capability is developed and included in the package. The words beside it say what the software provides.
A tick does not certify any client's implementation. Rates, configuration, imports, filing and review stay with the practitioner.
Whether a feature has been run against real data is recorded separately, in the validation status table in the README.
Cross: not included. Reference data: records only. Uses core: relies on the package that owns it. Controls added: extends a feature another package owns.
